experiment_data.hypothesis: Temporal DIF (2023 vs 2024 cohort) 在 METABENCH 的 ARC, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, TruthfulQA 上均展现与 MMLU 类似的显著 C% (>15%)，证明 temporal DIF 现象跨 benchmark 泛化，不是 MMLU 特有的 artifact。所有 benchmark 的 random-split control C% < 1%。

spec.eval_data: METABENCH response matrices for ARC, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, TruthfulQA

experiment_data.notes: All 6 METABENCH benchmarks show significant temporal DIF (17.9-31.3% ETS C), with all random controls <1%. Cross-benchmark consistency confirms temporal DIF is a universal phenomenon, not MMLU-specific. Knowledge/reasoning benchmarks (MMLU 31.3%, TruthfulQA 29.7%, ARC 26.9%, WinoGrande 30.3%) show higher C% than math/commonsense (GSM8K 18.9%, HellaSwag 17.9%).
